steps.en: After the 3rd letter, offender notices nearing due date get an e-reminder
steps.id: Setelah surat ke-3, notice offender yang hampir jatuh tempo dipilih untuk reminder
steps.why_en: The daily job is switched off in production settings, and UPL notices reaching the 3rd letter automatically is not proven.
steps.why_id: Job harian dimatikan di setelan produksi, dan notice UPL yang sampai ke surat ke-3 secara otomatis belum terbukti.

steps.en: Offender's latest mobile number is checked against the data source and updated
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru offender dicek ke sumber data lalu diperbarui
steps.why_en: The refresh from the data source is switched off in every environment, so the stored number is used instead.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan dari sumber data dimatikan di semua environment, jadi nomor yang tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Notices without a valid mobile number get no reminder
steps.id: Notice tanpa nomor mobile yang valid tidak dikirimi reminder

steps.en: The checked number is used for a reminder that refers to the 3rd letter
steps.id: Nomor hasil pengecekan dipakai untuk reminder yang merujuk ke surat ke-3
steps.why_en: The template to use is clear, but the message wording is stored outside the code, so the 3rd letter reference is unproven.
steps.why_id: Template yang dipilih jelas, tetapi redaksi pesan disimpan di luar code, jadi rujukan ke surat ke-3 belum terbukti.
